title: St Andrews study finds magnetic signature of repeated lightning strikes at Callanish

tellings.quote: research project by the University of St. Andrews where they did a geoysical analysis of a stone circle called the Kanish or Kalinase stone circle

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, who has his own theory about the purpose of ancient monuments, points to a study by the University of St Andrews in Scotland that measured the ground around the Callanish stone circle, a ring of ancient standing stones in Scotland. According to Drumm, the study found a magnetic trace left by lightning striking the site again and again. For him, this would hint that such monuments were tied to electricity in some way.
